desc:
🌀 Welcome to Chat RP Ragdoll — a physics simulation game where you can explore different worlds, experiment with ragdoll physics, and create your own adventures!

🎢 Discover unique maps filled with physics-based activities, obstacles, interactive objects, and exciting places to explore. Jump, fall, slide, and experience unpredictable ragdoll physics!

🎮 Experiment with different tools, interact with the environment, enjoy mini-games, and discover creative ways to have fun with physics.

🎭 Choose your role, participate in role-playing activities, and create unique gameplay moments with other players.

🌎 Explore multiple worlds, each offering different environments, activities, and physics-based experiences.

💻 Supported on: PC, phone, tablet, and VR.

⭐ Add the game to your favorites and leave a like to support future updates!

⚠️ Follow Roblox Community Standards and respect other players.
